# Education

```{r}
#| label: education
education <-
  read_yaml("data/education.yaml") |>
  mutate(why = sub("\n$", "", why)) |>
  separate_longer_delim(why, "\n")

if (BUILD == "resume") {
  education <-
    education |>
    filter(!startsWith(with, "Non-degree")) |>
    mutate(when = sub("^.*(?=[0-9]{4}$)", "Class of ", when, perl = TRUE))
}

education |>
  vitae::detailed_entries(what, when, with, where, why)
```
